why: The Union Railroad Station on Inland Avenue is a fenced, turret-guarded Wraith outpost in an abandoned rail station: a main building with an upper floor and rooftop antenna, a junk yard, a freight yard and a guarded gateway. In vanilla the station is only manned while the gig 'Flying Drugs' runs, so the clean slate leaves it empty. This proposal loads the station's quest/combat section and activates the 14-Wraith garrison in their default routine posts - gate, yard, tower, roof, upper floor and interior - while leaving the gig's scenes, reinforcements, loot and device actions out.

open_questions: Walk into the station from the road without the gig and check every door on the way. The gig route enters the main building and uses the ground-floor computer, so the doors should be passable; if a location door is sealed with no quest running, report which one, because the venue has no quest door actions for the runtime door policy to act on.

Count the Wraiths on the grounds and inside the station. Expect 14 at their posts (gate, yard, tower, roof, upper floor, interior); if they cluster at one spot or stand in cover, the individual 0default activations are not resolving and the whole-community form (blocked by the catalogue's alert posture) may be needed.
Look up at the roof and tower. guard_02 sits around z 70.8 and guard_06 around z 66.8; confirm the roof is reachable on foot and that a locked lift door is not the only way up there.
Check the station's security. Gate turrets and cameras are vanilla location devices and the proposal deliberately drives no device actions; confirm they are live and not left dead by a missing quest.

Decide the #ina_03_crowd_com question. bad_ina_phase activates a separate 5-Wraith crowd there whole, but the catalogue did not attach that community to this venue; if the yard still reads empty between the 14 garrison posts, add it in a follow-up venue entry.

communities.why: Gate guard. Vanilla's initial phase for him is #ina_03_ws_main_gate_guard_01_by_car, whose spots never resolved and whose edits depend on the gig; 0default puts him at his routine kneel-and-inspect spot by the gateway (1897.5, -546.2), which is the calm version of the same post.
Sniper on the roof (z 70.8) at a routine stand-ground spot, the highest post of the outpost; keeps the roof overwatch manned without any quest alert phase.
Elite gunner leaning on the yard table (1891.3, -549.9) in the 0default crowd, not the 'scene' or 'weld' specials: the everyday yard post.
Walking patrol on the north side of the yard (1894.5, -539.9). The record name is generic so the catalogue tags him civilian, but at this outpost it is a Wraith garrison archetype.
Grunt sitting at the drug table (1870.1, -547.1) on a routine sniff-drugs workspot, the outpost's downtime look; his other workspots are combat cover.
Tower guard standing at the window post (1878.9, -552.5, z 66.8), the overwatch above the yard; 0default keeps him at the tower rather than the gig's 'window' special.
Second sniper sitting inside the upper floor (1869.7, -545.5, z 61.0), the interior post the wiki describes as Wraiths inside the main building.
Operator on the phone by the back of the yard (1852.0, -556.0); the 0default talk-on-phone spot is his everyday post, while the gig's 'fixing' kneel only exists when the turret is being repaired.
Guard standing on the far west track side (1819.5, -541.0), the outer patrol post that makes the compound read as guarded from the railway.
East yard guard standing on the dirt (1924.5, -568.5), filling the cargo side of the compound.
Guard leaning on the east wall (1941.6, -547.2), the pair with guard_14 that watches the freight yard.
Guard standing around the freight yard beside guard_13 (1940.2, -549.6), a relaxed stand-around workspot.
Heavy machine-gunner standing in the south yard (1904.7, -578.0), the outpost's heavy weapon post facing the approach.
Patrolling guard in the middle of the compound (1884.4, -565.2), the only walker between the gate and the south yard.

proximity_wait.why: The ground-floor computer the gig hacks (ComputerControllerPS), 5.8 m from the garrison spots inside the devices section, so it streams with the people. A device, not a workspot (rule 8).
